title: Andrew Sorensen Keynote: "The Concert Programmer" - OSCON 2014
summary: Andrew Sorensen's OSCON 2014 keynote in which he live-codes generative music on stage using his Impromptu environment while narrating his computational and musical choices. It imagines concert programmers as a performing art.
why: HN commenters regard it as an inspiring, all-time favorite demonstration of live coding music.

quote.text: This video of one of his presentations on Impromptu is one of my all-time favorite programming talks
